title: Automatic reconnection after ignition
description: Verify that a previously paired phone reconnects automatically after an ignition cycle.
preconditions: Phone is paired; Bluetooth is enabled; ignition is off.
expectedResult: The phone reconnects automatically without user interaction.

title: Reconnection time verification
description: Measure the time required to reconnect a previously paired phone after ignition.
preconditions: Phone is paired and available; ignition is off.

title: Stored pairing reuse
description: Verify that stored pairing data is reused after an ignition cycle.
preconditions: Phone was paired before shutdown; pairing data is stored.
expectedResult: The phone reconnects without requesting a new pairing confirmation.

title: Transient failure retry
description: Verify that the system retries after one simulated transient connection failure.
preconditions: Phone is paired; the first connection attempt is configured to fail temporarily.
expectedResult: The system performs one retry and reconnects successfully.

title: Bluetooth profile restoration
description: Verify restoration of phone audio and media audio profiles after reconnection.
preconditions: Phone supports phone audio and media audio profiles.
expectedResult: Both supported profiles become available after reconnection.

title: Reconnection diagnostic logging
description: Verify that diagnostic events are recorded during a reconnection attempt.
preconditions: Diagnostic logging is enabled; phone is paired.
expectedResult: Start, completion, result, and duration events are recorded.

title: Repeated ignition cycle reconnection
description: Verify reconnection behavior over five consecutive ignition cycles.
preconditions: Phone is paired; five ignition cycles can be performed.
expectedResult: The phone reconnects automatically within 10 seconds during every cycle.

title: Weak-signal reconnection retry
description: Verify reconnection and retry behavior when the phone signal is temporarily weak.
preconditions: Phone is paired and placed near the edge of Bluetooth range.
expectedResult: The system retries if needed and reconnects within 10 seconds.

title: Delayed phone availability
description: Verify reconnection when the phone becomes available several seconds after ignition.
preconditions: Phone is paired; phone Bluetooth becomes available three seconds after ignition.
expectedResult: The system detects the phone and reconnects automatically.

title: Cold-start reconnection performance
description: Measure reconnection time after a complete infotainment system shutdown.
preconditions: Phone is paired; infotainment system is fully powered down.
expectedResult: The phone reconnects within 10 seconds after Bluetooth becomes available.
